estonia.description: Avioane de vânătoare ale forţelor aeriene suedeze au decolat vineri de două ori pentru a intercepta avioane de luptă ruseşti deasupra Mării Baltice, dar acestea nu au ajuns să încalce spaţiul aerian al Suediei, informează sâmbătă agenția de știri EFE. „Vineri, forţa de reacţie suedeză a efectuat două misiuni cu avioane JAS 39 Gripen pentru […] © G4Media.ro .

estonia.title: Estonia's Social Democrats push to criminalize deepfake explicit images
estonia.description: Fresh off the passage of Estonia's consent law, Social Democrats (SDE) are pushing to criminalize the nonconsensual creation and spread of sexually explicit deepfake images.

estonia.title: Banks taking on scammers with new Smart-ID+ upgrade
estonia.description: Banks in Estonia are rolling out a more secure version of the Smart-ID authentication system designed to better block common scam tactics with small extra steps for users.

estonia.title: Head of maritime school: Children need to respect the sea, not fear it
estonia.description: At the Sõru Maritime School on the Estonian island of Hiiumaa, children gain their first knowledge of sailing, behavior at sea, and safety. Around 20 students are currently enrolled, but interest in the school is high, with more applicants than places available.

estonia.title: Estonia makes prestigious SSL Gold Cup sailing finals in Rio de Janeiro
estonia.description: Estonia has made it to the Star Sailors League (SSL) Gold Cup 2026 finals in Rio de Janeiro after winning their European qualification group.

estonia.title: Estonian experts warn of risks as US eyes military drawdown in Europe
estonia.description: U.S. plans to slash military assets in Europe could create critical capability gaps, defense experts say, even as officials stress NATO plans remain intact.

estonia.title: Martin Mölder: The possible cost of an easy political victory
estonia.description: Estonia's opposition parties are likely headed for an easy win in the next elections, but the price of that easy victory may be that governing later becomes difficult, notes Martin Mölder.

estonia.title: Summer event rained out? Ticket holders have refund options
estonia.description: As Estonia heads into a busy summer event season, consumer protection officials are reminding ticket holders of their rights if an event is canceled or postponed.

estonia.title: Nearly 500 abandoned fishing nets pulled from Estonian side of Lake Peipus
estonia.description: Estonian officials removed hundreds of abandoned fishing nets from Lake Peipus during a four-day cleanup effort aimed at clearing long-lost and illegal gear.

estonia.title: Estonia, Sovereign Military Order of Malta sign healthcare and aid cooperation deal
estonia.description: An agreement has been signed which will advance the Sovereign Military Order of Malta's (SMOM) hospitaller and healthcare activities in Estonia.

estonia.title: 18 cattle die in Pärnu County BRSV outbreak
estonia.description: Eighteen cattle recently died in a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV) outbreak on a Pärnu County farm, Pärnu Postimees reported.

estonia.title: Tartu plant expands hazardous waste incinerator capacity to meet demand
estonia.description: A hazardous waste incineration plant in Tartu has expanded its capacity up to tenfold, aiming to handle up to 20,000 tons annually and address a national shortfall in disposal options.

estonia.title: Uku Varblane and Magnus Piirits: When pensions grow but life pulls ahead
estonia.description: The purchasing power of pensions has increased significantly over time and will continue to grow, but the main challenge will be whether pensions can keep up with the living standards of working-age people and how many risks we leave to be borne by a single pillar, write Uku Varblane and Magnus Piirits.

estonia.title: 2 killed in Rapla County road traffic accident
estonia.description: Two people were killed in a collision between a truck and a passenger vehicle in Kehtna, Rapla County, on Friday afternoon.

estonia.title: Gallery: Ukrainian artist's new Tallinn show explores violence 'everywhere'
estonia.description: Berlin-based Ukrainian artist Yeva Sihachova opened a new exhibition at Tallinn's Okapi Gallery on Thursday, exploring how violence seeps into everyday life.

estonia.title: Tartu unveils strategy to guide nightlife development through 2035
estonia.description: City officials have drafted a strategy to shape Tartu's evening and nighttime economy through 2035, aiming to balance vibrant urban life with business interests and residents' quality of life.

estonia.title: Experts: Estonian history lessons do not skirt round challenging topics
estonia.description: Studying controversial topics can help schoolchildren separate facts from propaganda, two education experts said.

estonia.title: New kindergarten enrollment rules still leave some families waiting
estonia.description: Despite a new law requiring local governments to provide kindergarten placements before a parent returns to work, some Estonian families have still been left waiting.

estonia.title: Government on crash course: Eesti 200 refuses to give up means-tested benefits
estonia.description: Eesti 200 leader Kristina Kallas said that the party does not agree with the governing coalition backing away from the goal of making family benefits means-tested and thereby saving €100 million annually.

estonia.title: Possible tornado reported Thursday as severe storms swept Southern Estonia
estonia.description: Fast-moving thunderstorms brought heavy rain, lightning and strong winds to Southern Estonia Thursday evening, with unconfirmed reports of a possible tornado in Võru County.

estonia.title: Experts say boosting R&D could help Estonia tackle rising public debt
estonia.description: Estonia's rising public debt is clouding its economic outlook, but experts say boosting investment in R&D‑intensive businesses — along with greater openness from officials to innovation — could help restore growth.

estonia.title: EDF intelligence: Russia has not achieved its strategic goals
estonia.description: Despite enormous efforts and losses, Russia has failed to achieve any of its strategic objectives over five years of the war in Ukraine, the Estonian Defense Forces' Intelligence Center wrote in its overview of the situation in Ukraine.

estonia.title: Ministry: No phosphorite mining to take place in Estonia for 'foreseeable future'
estonia.description: Mining and quarrying phosphorite in Estonia is not economically viable at any time in the near future, the Ministry of Climate said.

estonia.title: Margus Tsahkna: The cost of aggression must rise for Russia every day
estonia.description: If we want to reduce Russia's ability to continue its aggression against Ukraine, we must close all loopholes that allow its war industry to access the materials it needs, writes Margus Tsahkna.

estonia.title: €4.6 million EIS self-service platform to be developed
estonia.description: The Estonian Business and Innovation Agency (EIS) is seeking a partner to develop its digital services and self-service platform, with up to €4.6 million earmarked over three years.

estonia.title: Raimond Kaljulaid: Interests of large European countries might not align with Estonia's
estonia.description: The initiative by Europe's major powers — the so-called E3 of the United Kingdom, France and Germany — to open a political dialogue with Russia should make us very cautious, despite the fact that it is also supported by Finland and Ukraine, Raimond Kaljulaid writes.

estonia.title: Estonian athlete Marleen Mülla 12th in US NCAA Championships finals
estonia.description: Estonian pole vaulter Marleen Mülla finished 12th in the women's pole vault at the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) Championships in Eugene, Oregon.

estonia.title: Estonians marry less and divorce more often
estonia.description: According to data from Statistics Estonia, residents of Estonia entered into 5,998 marriages in 2025, 363 fewer than in 2024. This included 139 marriages between same-sex couples.

estonia.title: Estonia limits access to new credit register to loan applications only
estonia.description: Nearly one million loans, leases and debts will be consolidated into a single national credit register by 2029, allowing lenders to review applicants' financial obligations — but officials say the data will only be accessible when a formal loan application is made.

estonia.title: Photos: Ukraine's first lady opens Vabamu museum audio guide
estonia.description: First Lady of Ukraine Olena Zelenska officially inaugurated a Ukrainian-language audio guide at the Museum of Occupations and Freedom (Vabamu) in Tallinn on Wednesday.

estonia.title: Tallinn officials want street art to transform Pärnu maantee underpass
estonia.description: The City of Tallinn is commissioning street art to transform an underpass on Pärnu maantee, with a committee set to review designs for the large-scale project.

estonia.title: Harri Tiido: Comparing the present era with the past
estonia.description: In this background piece, history and the present are examined with the help of Odd Arne Westad. One alarming similarity to a hundred years ago is the accumulation of mutual accusations among great powers — particularly in relations between the United States and China, Harri Tiido notes.

estonia.title: Lihtsad uudised 12. juunil
estonia.description: "Lihtsad uudised," meaning easy or simple news, is for anyone who wants to improve their Estonian language skills. Listen and read a selection of this week's news stories below.

estonia.title: Piret Karro-Arrak: How do we remember our history?
estonia.description: The many opinions expressed about Alma Ostra-Oinas' equestrian monument provide an opportunity for a broader discussion about what we remember from our history and how we talk about it, writes Piret Karro-Arrak.

estonia.title: Tartu Aviation Academy drone test facility enlarges training scope
estonia.description: A new drone testing area in Tartu will bring a safe space for flying, development and experimentation of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs).

estonia.title: Tallinn erects modular bomb shelter in the heart of the city
estonia.description: Tallinn on Thursday installed a modular shelter in the green area at Juhkentali 10, the first shelter of its kind to be placed in public urban space in Estonia.

estonia.title: Estonia limits prosecutors general to one 7-year term
estonia.description: Next week, the Riigikogu will hold the second and third readings of amendments to the Prosecutor's Office Act that, among other changes, would limit the prosecutor general's term in office to a single consecutive seven-year period.

estonia.title: Tallinn City Council holds its longest sitting to date
estonia.description: The Tallinn City Council's final regular session before the summer recess lasted 14 hours and 17 minutes, likely making it the longest session in the council's history.

estonia.title: Estonia sees spa boom as tourism and spending habits shift
estonia.description: A wave of spa and spa hotel projects is spreading across Estonia's tourism and hospitality sectors as developers respond to cautious consumers and changing travel habits.

estonia.title: Leading cheesemaker E-Piim Tootmine asset sell-off starts
estonia.description: The sale of the assets of bankrupt dairy company E-Piim Tootmine began on Wednesday, with the company's production units in Paide, Põltsamaa and Järva-Jaani set to go up for public auction in August.

estonia.title: Estonian platform workers likely to be deemed employees in disputes
estonia.description: In legal disputes, platform couriers and ride-hailing drivers in Estonia would likely be classified as employees, according to a new Foresight Center-commissioned analysis.

estonia.title: Estonia renews calls for alumina export ban amid Ireland-Russia shipments
estonia.description: Estonia has once again called for a full ban on alumina exports from the European Union to Russia, Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna (Eesti 200) said.

estonia.title: Tallinn moves Ukrainian flag at Freedom Square onto scaffolding
estonia.description: Due to upcoming renovation work, the City of Tallinn will move the Estonian and Ukrainian flags displayed on the building at Freedom Square 10 onto scaffolding. If the war has not ended by the time the renovations are completed, the flags will be returned to the building's façade.

estonia.title: EKRE leader's clash over Viljandi post may cost deputy mayor her job
estonia.description: A failed bid by EKRE chair Martin Helme to appoint a political ally to a key post in Viljandi may cost a deputy mayor in that town her job, Sakala reported.

estonia.title: TalTech wants to terminate ministry cooperation agreement over difference of views
estonia.description: Tallinn University of Technology (TalTech) has proposed terminating its contract with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communications (MKM) to develop online courses for occupational health and safety specialists, citing significant differences between the parties' views on the scope and methodology of the courses.

estonia.title: TalTech scientists test AUV to better understand Estonia's seas
estonia.description: Scientists from Tallinn University of Technology (TalTech) recently tested a micro-autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) in the Baltic Sea for the first time, reaching areas inaccessible to conventional instruments.

estonia.title: Argo Ideon: Russian warbloggers as mouthpieces and their downfall
estonia.description: The fate of several Russian influencers shows that, in Russia, even loyalty to the country's imperialist ideology and sharing the Kremlin's contempt for the West and Ukraine does not protect bloggers from repression, writes Argo Ideon.

estonia.title: Remote bog island in Southern Estonia blanketed in blooming irises
estonia.description: In a remote lake in Southern Estonia's Emajõe-Suursooo marshland, a small bog island is covered in blooming Siberian irises, rewarding visitors up for making the watery trek.

estonia.title: Reform MP joins opposition's security agencies oversight inquiry
estonia.description: Opposition MPs from Isamaa have sent a letter to Interior Minister Igor Taro seeking clarification on how oversight of surveillance agencies is organized. Coalition MP Kalle Laanet also joined the inquiry.

estonia.title: Estonian lawmakers approve new nationwide loan register
estonia.description: The Riigikogu has approved legislation establishing a nationwide credit register aimed at giving lenders a clearer view of borrowers' loans.

estonia.title: Estonia-built rescue boats fall prey to Russian drones in Black Sea
estonia.description: Last week, two Ukrainian rescue vessels built at the Baltic Workboats shipyard were hit in the Black Sea while taking part in securing Ukraine's so-called grain corridor, Saarte Hääl reports.

estonia.title: Pühapäeval heisatakse Eesti lipud leinalipuna
estonia.description: Pühapäeval on Eestis küüditatute mälestamiseks lipu- ja leinapäev.

estonia.title: Glinka pääses Saksamaal finaali ja tegi Eesti tennise ajalugu
estonia.description: Eesti tennise teine reket Daniil Glinka jõudis Stuttagartis peetaval ATP 250 muruturniiril koos kreeklase Stefanos Sakellaridisega paarismängus finaali.

estonia.title: Taagepera: tehisaru kümne aasta areng oleks pidanud jaotuma saja aasta peale
estonia.description: ERR-ile antud intervjuus hoiatas 93-aastane kvantitatiivse politoloogia teerajaja Rein Taagepera, et maailm on jõudnud murrangulisse üleminekuaega: tarbimiskeskne eluviis põrkub planeedi piiridega, tehisintellekt areneb kiiremini, kui ühiskond suudab kohaneda, ning rahvusriikide asemele võivad tekkida uued üleilmsed võimuvõrgustikud.

estonia.title: Rootsi hävitajad saatsid piiri lähedal Vene sõjalennukeid
estonia.description: Rootsi tõstis eile õhku neli hävituslennukit JAS 39 Gripen, et saata kaht Läänemere kohal riigi õhuruumi lähistel lennanud Vene sõjalennukit, teatasid riigi kaitsejõud täna.

estonia.title: USA sai MMil hakkama saavutusega, mida viimati nähti 96 aastat tagasi
estonia.description: Ameerika Ühendriikide jalgpallikoondis näitas MM-finaalturniiril oma esimese kohtumisega kõigile kahtlejatele, et nad saavad ühe korraldajamaana survega hakkama ning esimesele vastasele Paraguayle näidati kindlalt koht kätte.

estonia.title: Apollo Klubi uuendab püsikliendikonto tingimusi
estonia.description: Apollo Grupp teatas, et alates 30. juunist jõustuvad Apollo Klubi püsikliendikonto uuendatud tingimused. Muudatused on seotud peamiselt püsikliendisüsteemi arendamise ja uue rakenduse kasutuselevõtuga.

estonia.title: Pikk tarneaeg tõi kliendile šokeeriva üllatuse ja raha tagasi: kukkel lössis ja kogu burger oli laiali vajunud
estonia.description: Kui klient tellis Viljandis asuvast VLND Burgerist toitu, pidi ta seda ootama üle tunni ning toidu saabudes oli burger külm ja tema hinnangul ka ülesoolatud. Burgerirestoran endas viga ei näe, kulleriteenus Wolt aga maksis kliendile kompensatsiooni.

estonia.title: LUGEMISSOOVITUS ⟩ Lugu naisest, kes julges teha seda, mida tal teha ei lubatud
estonia.description: Mis siis, kui aeg ei liiguks sirgjooneliselt, vaid voolaks nagu sulaklaas kuumas töökojas? Tracy Chevalier, kes vallutas maailma romaaniga «Tütarlaps pärlkõrvarõngaga», on kirjutanud uue lummava ajaloolise romaani «Klaasimeister». Raamat viib lugeja Veneetsia laguuni klaasisärasse Murano saarele, kus kunst, käsitöö ja saladused põimuvad sajandeid hõlmavaks jutustuseks.

estonia.title: Haridusminister tunnustas Tartu rahu skandaali tekitanud ametnikku palgatõusuga
estonia.description: Kuu algul tõstis Haridusministeerium keelepoliitika osakonna juhataja Andero Adamsoni palka. Alates 1. juunist on oma suhtumise tõttu Tartu rahusse kurikuulsaks saanud Adamsoni põhipalk 4300 eurot kuus. Pluss erinevad lisatasud, mida ametnik sai ka mullu.

estonia.title: KES ME OLEME? KUST ME TULEME? ⟩ Aivar Kriiska: inimese teekond võis alata juba 500 000 – 700 000 aastat tagasi
estonia.description: Tartu Ülikooli arheoloogia professor Aivar Kriiska räägib taskuhäälingute sarja järjekordses saates inimkonna kaugemast minevikust kõige uuemate teaduslike leidude kontekstis.

latvia.title: Kocsis Máté bocsánatot kért Magyar Péter édesanyjától
latvia.description: Mint írta: a politikai kultúra színvonalának emelése érdekében.

latvia.title: Tarr: Vége lehet a fólizásnak és az egyéves árfixálásnak
latvia.description: Tarr Zoltán miniszter a Könyvhét megnyitóján bocsánatot kért az előző miniszter és kormányok helyett a terület elhanyagoltsága miatt.

latvia.title: Lentulai Krisztián bocsánatot kért Magyar Péter anyjától
latvia.description: Amiért megosztotta Kocsis Máté becsületsértő posztját.

latvia.title: Ukrán dróncsapás ért egy személyvonatot a Krímben
latvia.description: Hétfőre virradóra felfüggesztették a járatok fogadását és indítását két moszkvai repülőtéren, valamint Jaroszlavlban, Kalugában, Nyizsnyij Novgorodban, Krasznodarban, Volgográdban és Szaratovban is.

latvia.title: Felmondott Papp Dániel, az MTVA vezérigazgatója
latvia.description: Az MTVA-t 2018 óta vezető Papp arra hivatkozott, hogy „az újonnan megválasztott kormány szándéka a közmédia teljes átalakítása.”

latvia.title: Vadászbombázókkal reagáltak a svédek a közelükben feltűnt orosz harci gépekre
latvia.description: NATO-repülőgépek is felszálltak.

latvia.title: Kiéheztetik a kulcsrégiót az ukránok, egyre több gondot okoznak a filléres fegyverek a NATO-nak - Háborús híreink pénteken
latvia.description: Az ukrán drónerők folyamatosan támadják a 2014-ben megszállt Krím-félszigetre vezető hidakat, vezetékeket, illetve hajókat, lényegében blokád alá vonva a területet. A pilóta nélküli járművek emellett az orosz energetikai infrastruktúrát is folyamatosan támadják, de éppen ez okozhat feszültséget a NATO-val: a Baltikumban és Romániában is egyre gyakrabban panaszkodnak a területükre belépő ukrán drónokra. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború legfontosabb híreivel.

latvia.title: Husák odchází z generálního štábu na velitelství NATO v Německu, píše iRozhlas
latvia.description: Dosavadní šéf Ředitelství zahraničních aktivit Generálního štábu Armády ČR Jan Husák odchází na jedno z velitelství Severoatlantické aliance (NATO) v Německu. Informoval o tom server iRozhlas, podle kterého bude radit s koordinací aktivit velitelství. Přidá se tak k hrstce Čechů sloužících v nejvyšších strukturách NATO, uvedl iRozhlas. Při té příležitosti bude Husákovi, nyní plukovníkovi, propůjčena hodnost brigádního generála. V pondělí o tom podle serveru má jednat vláda.

latvia.title: Polsko převzalo první stíhačky F-35
latvia.description: Polské ozbrojené síly oficiálně převzaly své první stíhací letouny F-35. Slavnostního ceremoniálu na základně v Lasku se účastnili představitelé vlády a zástupci armády. Jde o významný krok pro modernizaci polské armády a posílení závazků Varšavy vůči NATO. Zástupce USA na ceremoniálu oznámil, že Washington poskytne Polsku novou čtyřmiliardovou půjčku na americké vojenské vybavení. Stíhačky F-35 má od USA objednané i Česko.

latvia.title: Avioane de vânătoare suedeze au interceptat în două ocazii avioane de luptă ruseşti deasupra Mării Baltice
latvia.description: Avioane de vânătoare suedeze au interceptat în două ocazii avioane de luptă ruseşti deasupra Mării Baltice

latvia.title: A pune capăt dependenței UE de capacitățile SUA e una, a le refuza aliaților posibilitatea de a se apăra singuri e altceva (Politico)
latvia.description: Când s-a aflat că Pentagonul nu va vinde rachete Tomahawk cu rază lungă de acțiune Germaniei, s-a sugerat că Washingtonul s-ar putea teme că Moscova ar considera o astfel de capacitate în mâinile Europei drept o escaladare periculoasă. Măsura a venit în urma unor semne similare de retragere a SUA care se manifestau de câteva săptămâni, inclusiv decizia de a retrage 5.000 de soldați din Germania, de a opri desfășurarea planificată a unui batalion american echipat cu rachete Tomahawk și de a reduce drastic contribuțiile planificate ale SUA cu bombardiere, avioane de vânătoare, distrugătoare, submarine și alte forțe necesare pentru a consolida apărarea NATO în caz de criză sau atac.

latvia.title: Ucraina va cere 20 de miliarde de dolari de la aliați înainte de summitul NATO: „Vrem ca Rusia să ardă și mai tare”
latvia.description: Kievul intenționează să ceară aliaților încă 20 de miliarde de dolari la reuniunea Grupului de Contact pentru Apărarea Ucrainei din 18 iunie, argumentând că fondurile sunt necesare pentru menținerea avantajului obținut pe front și pentru continuarea atacurilor asupra infrastructurii și capacităților militare ruse, relatează Politico.

latvia.title: Aliații NATO vor să îi ofere comandantului Forțelor aliate din Europa mai multă libertate de acțiune în doborârea dronelor
latvia.description: Țările membre NATO doresc să-i acorde comandantului militar suprem al alianței o mai mare libertate de acțiune în ceea ce privește doborârea dronelor până la summitul liderilor de luna viitoare de la Ankara, potrivit a doi diplomați NATO și a unui oficial al alianței, relatează Politico.

latvia.title: Cine este Dan Neculăescu, propunerea lui Eugen Tomac pentru Ministerul Apărării
latvia.description: Dan Neculăescu (Dănuţ Sebastian Neculăescu) este propunerea premierului desemnat Eugen Tomac pentru funcţia de ministru al Apărării Naţionale în noul cabinet. În momentul nominalizării de către premierul desemnat, Neculăescu exercită mandatul de ambasador şi reprezentant permanent al României la NATO, funcţie în care a fost numit în februarie 2022 de preşedintele de la acea vreme, Klaus Iohannis

latvia.title: Avertismentul Suediei: Rusia ar putea pune în curând NATO la încercare. „Ei ştiu că Occidentul se reînarmează. De ce-ar mai aştepta?”
latvia.description: O ofensivă militară rusă împotriva unor state membre NATO ar putea avea loc în viitorul „relativ apropiat”, dacă Putin consideră momentul oportun, a avertizat vineri Comisia parlamentară a Apărării din Suedia, relatează AFP.

latvia.title: Expert în securitate, la Pașaport Diplomatic: „Marea Neagră devine centrul NATO”
latvia.description: Marea Neagră rămâne o zonă strategică tensionată, iar războiul din Ucraina îi redefinește rolul în arhitectura de securitate europeană. Cu România și flancul estic al NATO în prima linie, fiecare mișcare diplomatică sau militară din această regiune are consecințe directe asupra stabilității unui întreg continent. Glenn Howard, preşedintele Fundaţiei Saratoga din Statele Unite și expert în Rusia, a împărtăşit la „Pașaport Diplomatic” viziunea lui despre cât de importantă devine Marea Neagră.

latvia.title: NATO a declanșat cel mai înalt nivel de alertă de apărare aeriană după ce un avion de pasageri israelian a provocat panică
latvia.description: NATO a declanșat joi cel mai înalt nivel de alertă de apărare aeriană după ce Ungaria a mobilizat avioane de luptă pentru a intercepta un avion de pasageri israelian care nu a reușit să stabilească contactul cu controlorii de trafic aerian în timp ce survola spațiul aerian ungar, scrie TVPWorld.

latvia.title: NYT: SUA vor reduce drastic numărul de avioane și nave de război destinate operațiunilor NATO în Europa
latvia.description: Administrația Trump pregătește o reducere semnificativă a avioanelor și navelor de război alocate operațiunilor NATO în Europa, inclusiv a unor avioane de luptă, aeronave de recunoaștere și nave militare, potrivit publicației New York Times, care citează doi înalți oficiali europeni.

latvia.title: Rusia îşi extinde prezenţa militară în apropierea graniței cu NATO şi se pregăteşte pentru un eventual război, dezvăluie o nouă anchetă
latvia.description: Rusia şi-a extins infrastructura militară în apropierea graniţei cu statele membre NATO şi se pregăteşte pentru un eventual război, a relevat o anchetă realizată pe 10 iunie de postul public danez DR şi de mai multe instituţii partenere, citată de The Kyiv Independent.

latvia.title: Helen Mirren: „Forţele răului sunt prezente şi în Israelul de astăzi. Ai crede că e imposibil să se repete aceleași lucruri”
latvia.description: Helen Mirren a declarat joi, la Festivalul de Film de la Taormina, că forţele răului sunt prezente şi în Israelul de astăzi, respingând acuzaţia că ar fi sionistă, aşa cum i s-a strigat pe o stradă din Londra în urmă cu doi ani, într-un videoclip care a fost publicat abia recent şi care a devenit viral, informează ANSA.

latvia.title: Mark Rutte transmite un mesaj de reasigurare pentru Europa: SUA rămân „pe deplin angajate” față de NATO
latvia.description: Secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, a declarat joi că Statele Unite rămân pe deplin angajate față de alianță, încercând să liniștească partenerii europeni pe fondul unei scăderi accentuate a încrederii opiniei publice în Washington, anunță TVP World.

latvia.title: Daniel Zamfir (PSD): Votul nostru pentru guvernul Tomac va fi în funcție de programul de guvernare pe care ni-l va prezenta
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor PSD, Daniel Zamfir, a declarat, joi, la Digi24, că PSD va susține un guvern condus de Eugen Tomac dacă programul de guvernare pe care îl va prezenta premierul desemnat va conține măsurile cerute de social-democrați.

latvia.title: Meloni îndeamnă NATO să-și reconsidere cheltuielile pentru apărare: „Am văzut tancuri care costă milioane de euro distruse de drone”
latvia.description: Italia își va majora bugetul oficial al apărării în acest an, însă aliații NATO ar trebui să-și regândească prioritățile militare, având în vedere că modul de desfășurare a războiului se transformă odată cu apariția dronelor, a sateliților și a datelor, a declarat joi prim-ministrul Giorgia Meloni, relatează Reuters.

latvia.title: Număr record de consultații medicale pentru Trump: 22 de specialiști implicați în ultimul control. Liderul SUA: „Sunt perfect sănătos”
latvia.description: Președintele american Donald Trump s-a prezentat la 22 de medici specialiști în cadrul controlului medical anual de luna trecută, aproape dublând numărul consultărilor din anii precedenți și stabilind, aparent, un record prezidențial, potrivit unei noi analize citate de The Independent.

latvia.title: Ucraina cere autorităților din Luxemburg să-și reconsidere planurile privind concertul sopranei Anna Netrebko, susținătoare a lui Putin
latvia.description: Ambasada Ucrainei în Luxemburg și-a exprimat îngrijorarea cu privire la concertul cântăreței de operă ruse Anna Netrebko, programat să aibă loc pe 15 iunie la Filarmonica din Luxemburg, și a adus această problemă în atenția autorităților.

latvia.title: Avioane de vânătoare JAS 39 Gripen, ridicate de urgență de la sol de Suedia pentru interceptarea unor aeronave rusești
latvia.description: Suedia a anunțat sâmbătă că a dispus decolarea de urgență a două perechi de avioane de vânătoare JAS 39 Gripen pentru a intercepta două avioane de luptă rusești care survolau Marea Baltică în apropierea spațiului său aerian, scrie AFP. latvia.title: Avioane de vânătoare suedeze au interceptat în două ocazii avioane de luptă ruseşti deasupra Mării Baltice
latvia.description: Avioane de vânătoare ale forţelor aeriene suedeze au decolat vineri de două ori pentru a intercepta avioane de luptă ruseşti deasupra Mării Baltice, dar acestea nu au ajuns să încalce spaţiul aerian al Suediei, informează sâmbătă agenția de știri EFE. „Vineri, forţa de reacţie suedeză a efectuat două misiuni cu avioane JAS 39 Gripen pentru […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Estonian experts warn of risks as US eyes military drawdown in Europe
latvia.description: U.S. plans to slash military assets in Europe could create critical capability gaps, defense experts say, even as officials stress NATO plans remain intact.

latvia.title: Books and barons: the Latvian return of Freiherr Campenhausen
latvia.description: Lēdurga recently welcomed a special guest. A descendant of the Baltic-German family that founded the village returned for a private charity initiative – together with German-language books for the local library.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: June 12th, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: OECD presents numerous ideas to improve Latvia's economy
latvia.description: The Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) has published a new OECD Economic Survey of Latvia, which runs the rule over the current state of the Latvian economy and its future prospects. These surveys are conducted every two years for all OECD member states, with this one launched on the occasion of Latvia’s 10th anniversary of joining the OECD.

latvia.title: Invitation to enjoy European Archaeology Days this weekend in Latvia
latvia.description: This weekend sees several European Archaeology Days events taking place in Latvia.

latvia.title: Where to find crisis information in Latvia?
latvia.description: In the event of a major incident, crisis or military conflict in Latvia, there are several sources of information to which you can turn. Here is a brief summary of them with links provided.

latvia.title: Spot a bear? Tell everyone, Latvian nature agency asks
latvia.description: Brown bears are becoming increasingly common in Latvia, which is why public sightings are also becoming more important. The Nature Conservation Agency (DAP) urges anyone who has spotted a bear or signs of its presence to report it on the nature observation portal "Dabas dati", providing as accurate information as possible and, if possible, a photograph (but don't go out of your way to take one).

latvia.title: Latvia's election digital platform developing smoothly, says agency
latvia.description: Digital election system development is going according to plan, said State Digital Development Agency (VDAA) on June 12.

latvia.title: What hinders Rīga's construction pace?
latvia.description: How easy is it to start building a house in Riga? This was investigated by representatives of the LaSER think tank, who regularly monitor the development of Rīga and other Latvian cities. The experts concluded that the process is fragmented and that there are currently two spatial plans in effect in Rīga, Latvian Radio reported on June 12.

latvia.title: No heat expected in Latvia in coming days
latvia.description: Rainy weather will continue in Latvia over the next few days, and no heat is expected, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: Latvia and Portugal get new cargo shipping connection
latvia.description: Shipping company Ocean Network Express (ONE) has launched a new weekly route through the Port of Riga – Iberia Baltic Express (IBX).

latvia.title: Latvian actor Pauls Butkēvičs passes away
latvia.description: Latvian actor Pauls Butkēvičs, who played approximately 150 roles during his film career, has died at the age of 85, announced Marta Bite, the chairwoman of the board of the Latvian Cinematographers' Union, citing information from the actor's relatives.

latvia.title: Latvian/Estonian twin city festival taking place
latvia.description: The twin cities of Valka (Latvia) and Valga (Estonia) are the place or places to head to this weekend as they celebrate their joint city festival.

latvia.title: Ukrainian vehicles will be parked by Freedom Monument in Rīga
latvia.description: Specialized vehicles used in evacuation missions from the Ukrainian front will be temporarily stationed at the Freedom Monument in central Rīga from June 13th to June 18th.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Rainbows, Beer, Final Festival
latvia.description: Festivals galore! What will it be this weekend?

latvia.title: Traffic restrictions during Rīga Pride march on Saturday
latvia.description: Due to the Riga Pride 2026 parade and following events at the Esplanāde Park on Saturday, June 13, traffic restrictions will be in place in the city centre, the Rīga City Council said.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: KiVa programme anti-bullying conference
latvia.description: As previously reported by LSM, the KiVa anti-bullying programme conference is taking place in Rīga on Friday and features speakers from Finland, Norway, the United Kingdom, and the Czech Republic, with the aim of sharing experience, knowledge, and inspiration.

latvia.title: Agriculture output prices down in first quarter
latvia.description: In the first quarter of 2026, the average price of agricultural output in the EU decreased by 2.9% compared with the same quarter in 2025. This was a slightly higher rate of decline than that of the last quarter of 2025 (-1.7%) according to data on agricultural price indices published by Eurostat.

latvia.title: Latvia risks being kicked out of space affairs
latvia.description: Latvia joined the European Space Agency in 2020; however, funding for the country’s continued membership is no longer included in the multiannual budget for next year, according to Minister of Education and Science Ilze Indriksone (National Alliance). Is Latvia’s membership in the agency at risk? There is no answer to that yet, Latvian Television reported on June 11.

latvia.title: Wider buffer zone planned along Latvian border
latvia.description: To strengthen the security of the country’s borders and maintain its infrastructure, a 30-metre buffer zone is planned to be established along Latvia’s external land border. This is provided for in the urgent amendments to the Protective Zone Law, which were supported in the final reading by the Saeima on Thursday, June 11, as reported by the Saeima Press Service.

latvia.title: Latvian Saeima nays banning cage-raised chickens
latvia.description: On Thursday, June 11, the Saeima rejected in the first reading the proposed amendments to the Animal Protection Law, which would have banned the keeping of laying hens in cages with a transition period until 2032.

latvia.title: Church loses roof in storm in Bebrene, Latvia
latvia.description: In Bebrene Parish, Augšdaugava Municipality, strong winds tore off approximately two-thirds of the roof of St. John the Baptist Catholic Church on Thursday, June 11 evening, confirmed Pēteris Dzalbe, executive director of the Augšdaugava Municipality.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 11th June, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: 31,555 Ukrainians currently have refuge in Latvia
latvia.description: More than 31,000 Ukrainians are currently finding refuge in Latvia, according to the latest Eurostat figures.

latvia.title: Senior tax official: poor political decision-making encourages smuggling
latvia.description: Political decisions, including ill-thought-through bans on e-cigarettes and flavoured liquids, have encouraged smuggling, said Baiba Šmite-Roķe, Director General of the State Revenue Service (VID), at a forum on smuggling issues on Thursday.

latvia.title: Latvia's insolvency service is itself liquidated
latvia.description: On Thursday, June 11, Latvia's parliament, the Saeima, adopted amendments to the Insolvency Law and related laws in the final reading, which liquidate the Insolvency Control Service and transfer its functions to the Ministry of Justice, the Court Administration and the Latvian Association of Insolvency Administrators. From now on, the Ministry of Justice will have to supervise insolvency administrators.

latvia.title: Latvian company buys Estonian fish processor
latvia.description: Latvian AS "Brīvais vilnis" has bought the Estonian fish processing company "Saare Kala Tootmine", the company said in a statement.

latvia.title: Latvians spent EUR 1.8 billion on short trips last year
latvia.description: According to the data of the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB), published on June 11, in 2025, residents of Latvia spent a total of EUR 1,799 billion on short trips around Latvia and abroad. Domestic tourism declined slightly last year, while the number of trips abroad increased.

latvia.title: Latvian border guards issue wedding reminder
latvia.description: As the summer wedding season begins, the Latvian State Border Guard is calling on newlyweds to pay attention to the preparation of travel documents such as passports and eID cards to avoid what might become a disappointing and extremely short honeymoon.

latvia.title: Latvian police apprehend drunken quad biker with kid
latvia.description: State Police officers detained a quadricycle driver after a chase in Bauska, who, ignoring repeated requests to stop, tried to flee from law enforcement officers.

latvia.title: Puffy pillows: half a million cigarettes found labelled as 'bed linen'
latvia.description: Officials of the Customs Department of the State Revenue Service (VID) have seized more than half a million contraband cigarettes that were labelled as 'bed linen' in import documents.

latvia.title: Public warned to be on guard against telephone pension scam
latvia.description: A warning has been issued about a currently popular telephone fraud scheme operating in Latvia.

latvia.title: Survey suggests nearly everyone in Latvia feels financial stress
latvia.description: A recent survey by Swedbank Latvia shows that 92% of residents experience financial stress in various forms, Swedbank said in a release on June 11.

latvia.title: Former PM and ministers resume their Saeima seats
latvia.description: On Thursday, June 11, the parliamentary seats of former Prime Minister Evika Siliņa (New Unity) and two former ministers were reinstated.

latvia.title: Local road washed out after maintenance in Latvia
latvia.description: Shortly after ditch-cleaning work carried out by "Latvian State Roads" on the Ugāle–Cirkale–Zlēkas section of the Ventspils municipality road, the road was washed out, and potholes that pose a danger to traffic quickly formed. "Latvian State Roads" promises to repair the damage, but additional reinforcement of the ditches is not planned, TV Kurzeme reported.

latvia.title: Diaspora youth will be subject to obligatory defence service in Latvia
latvia.description: Starting next year, Latvian citizens living abroad will also be eligible for conscription into the mandatory State Defence Service. According to rough estimates, 1,000 young people in the UK could meet the requirements for national defence service next year; however, interest from the diaspora has been very low so far.

latvia.title: Unauthorised GMO tomatoes found in Latvia
latvia.description: The Plant Protection Service has discovered the sale of unauthorised genetically modified tomato seedlings in Latvia. The variety in question is dark purple in colour and was developed by a U.S. biotechnology company, Latvian Radio reported on June 10.

latvia.title: Balticovo hopes to egg-cel with new production plant
latvia.description: On Wednesday, June 10, the new production complex of the egg production company "Balticovo" was officially opened in Iecava; approximately 120 million euros were invested in its construction, the company reported.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 10th June, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvian rock musician Johnny Salamander dies aged 60
latvia.description: Latvian rock musician Jānis Gūža, better known by his stage name Johnny Salamander, passed away on the morning of June 10 at the age of 60, his family announced on Facebook.

latvia.title: Rīga Central Market's meat pavilion ordered to close immediately
latvia.description: The State Construction Control Bureau (BVKB) inspected the Meat Pavilion at Rīga Central Market on Wednesday, and as of Thursday, June 11, it will be closed.

latvia.title: Using NATO jets to down drones not a long-term solution, say Latvian President and PM
latvia.description: The use of NATO fighter jets to protect Latvian airspace and shoot down foreign drones, which happened for the first time in Latvia on Monday, is not a long-term solution. Instead, the country should focus on developing and strengthening its air defence capabilities. This was stated by President Edgars Rinkēvičs and Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (Joint List) at their weekly press conference after a bilateral meeting on Wednesday, June 10th (video below).

latvia.title: Actor Richard Gere talks Tibetan Buddhism on Latvian Television
latvia.description: The popular Hollywood actor Richard Gere appeared on Latvian television's Viens pret Vienu (One on One) in-depth interview show this week, talking mainly about the role of Buddhism in his life.

latvia.title: Orange alert for rain and hail in Latvia on Thursday
latvia.description: Heavy rain is expected in Latvia on Thursday, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: Flights diverted from Rīga to Tallinn over drone suspicions Tuesday
latvia.description: Two planes en route to Rīga were diverted to Tallinn Airport on Tuesday evening. Passengers shared this information on the social media platform Facebook, where the discussion has since been deleted. A representative from “Latvian Air Traffic” explained that the flights were diverted due to a drone that was reportedly spotted, but unconfirmed, Latvian Radio reports on June 10.

latvia.title: Latvian and Polish ammo makers to cooperate
latvia.description: Latvian ammunition manufacturer Ammunity said on June 10th it has started to cooperate with one of Poland’s most important defence companies.

latvia.title: Interview: Bacterial resistance risks deaths from simple infections
latvia.description: The world is facing a silent pandemic that many don’t even notice – antimicrobial resistance. Bacteria are becoming resistant to antibiotics and threatening the lives of many people, says professor Dimitri Van der Linden, a paediatric infectious disease specialist from Belgium, in an interview with Latvian Radio's Laura Dzērve.

latvia.title: Bloomsday book giveaway at Latvian National Library
latvia.description: Fans of literature in general and Irish literature in particular will be delighted to learn that on June 16th they can obtain a free example of Irish writing, available in both English and Latvian.

latvia.title: Subscriptions open for first IPO of a state-owned company in Latvia
latvia.description: The subscription for the shares of LAU Infra Group AS within the framework of the initial public offering (IPO) begins today, June 10th. The company will publicly offer up to 6,400,421 shares, which are planned to be listed on the Nasdaq Riga Baltic Main List after the IPO.

latvia.title: Organic farming has deep roots in Valmiera district
latvia.description: There is a growing interest in organic farming in rural Latvia, and one of the reasons is to be less dependent on external resources, as the price of mineral fertilizers is increasing, and plant protection products will also become more expensive, reports Latvian Radio from northern Vidzeme region.

lithuania.description: Az ukrán drónerők folyamatosan támadják a 2014-ben megszállt Krím-félszigetre vezető hidakat, vezetékeket, illetve hajókat, lényegében blokád alá vonva a területet. lithuania.title: Husák odchází z generálního štábu na velitelství NATO v Německu, píše iRozhlas

Informoval o tom server iRozhlas, podle kterého bude radit s koordinací aktivit velitelství. Přidá se tak k hrstce Čechů sloužících v nejvyšších strukturách NATO, uvedl iRozhlas. lithuania.title: A pune capăt dependenței UE de capacitățile SUA e una, a le refuza aliaților posibilitatea de a se apăra singuri e altceva (Politico)
lithuania.description: Când s-a aflat că Pentagonul nu va vinde rachete Tomahawk cu rază lungă de acțiune Germaniei, s-a sugerat că Washingtonul s-ar putea teme că Moscova ar considera o astfel de capacitate în mâinile Europei drept o escaladare periculoasă. Măsura a venit în urma unor semne similare de retragere a SUA care se manifestau de câteva săptămâni, inclusiv decizia de a retrage 5.000 de soldați din Germania, de a opri desfășurarea planificată a unui batalion american echipat cu rachete Tomahawk și de a reduce drastic contribuțiile planificate ale SUA cu bombardiere, avioane de vânătoare, distrugătoare, submarine și alte forțe necesare pentru a consolida apărarea NATO în caz de criză sau atac.

lithuania.title: Aliații NATO vor să îi ofere comandantului Forțelor aliate din Europa mai multă libertate de acțiune în doborârea dronelor
lithuania.description: Țările membre NATO doresc să-i acorde comandantului militar suprem al alianței o mai mare libertate de acțiune în ceea ce privește doborârea dronelor până la summitul liderilor de luna viitoare de la Ankara, potrivit a doi diplomați NATO și a unui oficial al alianței, relatează Politico.

lithuania.title: Cine este Dan Neculăescu, propunerea lui Eugen Tomac pentru Ministerul Apărării

În momentul nominalizării de către premierul desemnat, Neculăescu exercită mandatul de ambasador şi reprezentant permanent al României la NATO, funcţie în care a fost numit în februarie 2022 de preşedintele de la acea vreme, Klaus Iohannis

lithuania.title: Avertismentul Suediei: Rusia ar putea pune în curând NATO la încercare. „Ei ştiu că Occidentul se reînarmează. De ce-ar mai aştepta?”
lithuania.description: O ofensivă militară rusă împotriva unor state membre NATO ar putea avea loc în viitorul „relativ apropiat”, dacă Putin consideră momentul oportun, a avertizat vineri Comisia parlamentară a Apărării din Suedia, relatează AFP.

lithuania.title: Expert în securitate, la Pașaport Diplomatic: „Marea Neagră devine centrul NATO”
lithuania.description: Marea Neagră rămâne o zonă strategică tensionată, iar războiul din Ucraina îi redefinește rolul în arhitectura de securitate europeană. Cu România și flancul estic al NATO în prima linie, fiecare mișcare diplomatică sau militară din această regiune are consecințe directe asupra stabilității unui întreg continent. Glenn Howard, preşedintele Fundaţiei Saratoga din Statele Unite și expert în Rusia, a împărtăşit la „Pașaport Diplomatic” viziunea lui despre cât de importantă devine Marea Neagră.

lithuania.title: NATO a declanșat cel mai înalt nivel de alertă de apărare aeriană după ce un avion de pasageri israelian a provocat panică
lithuania.description: NATO a declanșat joi cel mai înalt nivel de alertă de apărare aeriană după ce Ungaria a mobilizat avioane de luptă pentru a intercepta un avion de pasageri israelian care nu a reușit să stabilească contactul cu controlorii de trafic aerian în timp ce survola spațiul aerian ungar, scrie TVPWorld.

lithuania.title: NYT: SUA vor reduce drastic numărul de avioane și nave de război destinate operațiunilor NATO în Europa
lithuania.description: Administrația Trump pregătește o reducere semnificativă a avioanelor și navelor de război alocate operațiunilor NATO în Europa, inclusiv a unor avioane de luptă, aeronave de recunoaștere și nave militare, potrivit publicației New York Times, care citează doi înalți oficiali europeni.

lithuania.title: Rusia îşi extinde prezenţa militară în apropierea graniței cu NATO şi se pregăteşte pentru un eventual război, dezvăluie o nouă anchetă
lithuania.description: Rusia şi-a extins infrastructura militară în apropierea graniţei cu statele membre NATO şi se pregăteşte pentru un eventual război, a relevat o anchetă realizată pe 10 iunie de postul public danez DR şi de mai multe instituţii partenere, citată de The Kyiv Independent.

lithuania.title: Mark Rutte transmite un mesaj de reasigurare pentru Europa: SUA rămân „pe deplin angajate” față de NATO
lithuania.description: Secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, a declarat joi că Statele Unite rămân pe deplin angajate față de alianță, încercând să liniștească partenerii europeni pe fondul unei scăderi accentuate a încrederii opiniei publice în Washington, anunță TVP World.

lithuania.title: Daniel Zamfir (PSD): Votul nostru pentru guvernul Tomac va fi în funcție de programul de guvernare pe care ni-l va prezenta
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor PSD, Daniel Zamfir, a declarat, joi, la Digi24, că PSD va susține un guvern condus de Eugen Tomac dacă programul de guvernare pe care îl va prezenta premierul desemnat va conține măsurile cerute de social-democrați.

lithuania.title: Meloni îndeamnă NATO să-și reconsidere cheltuielile pentru apărare: „Am văzut tancuri care costă milioane de euro distruse de drone”
lithuania.description: Italia își va majora bugetul oficial al apărării în acest an, însă aliații NATO ar trebui să-și regândească prioritățile militare, având în vedere că modul de desfășurare a războiului se transformă odată cu apariția dronelor, a sateliților și a datelor, a declarat joi prim-ministrul Giorgia Meloni, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Număr record de consultații medicale pentru Trump: 22 de specialiști implicați în ultimul control. Liderul SUA: „Sunt perfect sănătos”
lithuania.description: Președintele american Donald Trump s-a prezentat la 22 de medici specialiști în cadrul controlului medical anual de luna trecută, aproape dublând numărul consultărilor din anii precedenți și stabilind, aparent, un record prezidențial, potrivit unei noi analize citate de The Independent.

lithuania.title: Ucraina cere autorităților din Luxemburg să-și reconsidere planurile privind concertul sopranei Anna Netrebko, susținătoare a lui Putin
lithuania.description: Ambasada Ucrainei în Luxemburg și-a exprimat îngrijorarea cu privire la concertul cântăreței de operă ruse Anna Netrebko, programat să aibă loc pe 15 iunie la Filarmonica din Luxemburg, și a adus această problemă în atenția autorităților.

lithuania.description: U.S. plans to slash military assets in Europe could create critical capability gaps, defense experts say, even as officials stress NATO plans remain intact.

lithuania.title: Using NATO jets to down drones not a long-term solution, say Latvian President and PM
lithuania.description: The use of NATO fighter jets to protect Latvian airspace and shoot down foreign drones, which happened for the first time in Latvia on Monday, is not a long-term solution. Instead, the country should focus on developing and strengthening its air defence capabilities. This was stated by President Edgars Rinkēvičs and Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (Joint List) at their weekly press conference after a bilateral meeting on Wednesday, June 10th (video below).

lithuania.description: Seimas šią savaitę pradėjo svarstyti neįsigaliojusio Lietuvos ir Baltarusijos susitarimo dėl pasienio gyventojų kelionių tvarkos denonsavimą.

lithuania.description: Ukrainos kariai įgyvendino netradicinę gelbėjimo misiją fronto linijoje, jai panaudodami dideliam svoriui skirtą droną „Vampyras“, kad evakuotų katę ir penkis jos kačiukus, skelbia 118-oji atskiroji mechanizuotoji brigada.

lithuania.title: Šiaurės Korėja protestuoja prieš Seulo ir ES pasmerkimą dėl Pchenjano karinių ryšių su Rusija

lithuania.description: JAV ir Irano taikos susitarimas tikriausiai bus galutinai parengtas per artimiausias 24 valandas, šeštadienį pareiškė Pakistano ministras pirmininkas Shehbazas Sharifas (Šehbazas Šarifas), kurio vyriausybė tarpininkauja tarp Teherano ir Vašingtono siekdama padėti užbaigti karą.
